dimensions.assessment: Affects state-level administration in Mississippi and visitors to the Vicksburg National Military Park.
dimensions.evidence: convey to the State of Mississippi... the Federal land described... to be used in accordance with subsection (c)

dimensions.assessment: Involves a localized land conveyance of roughly 7 acres for an interpretive center and public access facilitation.
dimensions.evidence: The parcel of approximately 1.69 acres... The parcel of approximately 5.74 acres

dimensions.assessment: The land is conveyed without consideration, involving no direct federal spending or grant appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: convey to the State of Mississippi (referred to in this Act as the 'State'), by quitclaim deed and without consideration

dimensions.assessment: Modifies the boundary of a single national military park and executes a specific property conveyance.
dimensions.evidence: To modify the boundary of the Vicksburg National Military Park in the State of Mississippi, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent boundary modification and transfer of ownership for the specified parcels.
dimensions.evidence: On conveyance of the Federal land described in subsection (a), the Secretary shall modify the boundary of the Park to exclude the Federal land conveyed.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill directs the Department of the Interior to convey two parcels totaling approximately 7 acres within the Vicksburg National Military Park to the State of Mississippi without consideration for an interpretive center, modifying the park boundary accordingly.
